CONTRACT-SOURCE DISAGREEMENT (explicit, as asked): YES, the two declared sources disagree with each other here, before reality even enters. See setup step 1 for full detail - the response schema declares `template`, `created_by`, and `creator_details` (with sub-fields) on each bin row; the flat `returns` array does not list any of the three. A schema-only addition, like this one, is therefore invisible to it in both directions of CI on both environments - this is a static/documentation-level fact, not something either environment's live data can be blamed for or credited with.

ENVELOPE AND BEHAVIOR (everything that COULD be exercised, matched the declared contract exactly, on prod): status 200, response_keys {success, test_cases, metadata}, metadata sub-keys {total, page, page_size, total_pages} all present and correctly typed; total_pages correctly 0 (not 1) when total is 0, matching preprod's prior observation.
